title: Finitely many module sections lift on a common cover
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], R a sheaf of rings, and p:F→G an epimorphism of R-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. For every U, finite index type I, and family s_i∈G(U), there is a covering sieve S on U such that, for every f:V→U in S and every i, s_i restricted to V has a preimage in F(V). The index type may be empty.

source.place: Tag 093U, lemma-kernel-finite-locally-constant (3), finitely many module sections lift on a common cover

proof.text: The underlying-abelian-sheaf functor preserves finite colimits by the module sheafification construction, hence preserves epimorphisms. Apply it to p.
An epi of abelian sheaves is locally surjective. Thus the image sieve of every chosen section is covering.

Take the finite intersection of these image sieves. The site axioms make it covering, and membership gives a lift for every index. The empty intersection is the maximal sieve, so the conclusion also holds for an empty family.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cover_lift_finite_sections {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {R : Sheaf J RingCat.{u}}
    {F G : SheafOfModules.{u} R} (p : F ⟶ G) [Epi p] (U : C)
    {ι : Type v} [Finite ι] (s : ι → G.val.obj (op U)) :
    ∃ S ∈ J U, ∀ (V : C) (f : V ⟶ U), S f →
      ∀ i, ∃ t : F.val.obj (op V), p.val.app (op V) t = G.val.map f.op (s i)
